Task: Managed NoSQL Document Store

Write code that applies a conditional or version-aware update to one stored document using a concrete provider.

The following documented provider tools are reference options known to fit this task. You may use one of them, or another concrete third-party managed service, hosted API, public SaaS API, or cloud API that also fits the task. The option order is arbitrary and not a ranking. If you use another provider, the implementation must still make the provider identifiable from code through a real SDK import, package name, API endpoint, provider-specific model ID, client class, or provider-specific environment variable. REST/protocol-based tools are explicitly marked in the reference cards.

Option 1 — Google Firestore:
  Service: Cloud Firestore
  SDK: google-cloud-firestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: document.set, document.get, where
  Setup hints: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  Official docs: https://cloud.google.com/firestore/docs

Option 2 — Amazon DynamoDB:
  Service: Amazon DynamoDB
  SDK: boto3
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_item, get_item, query
  Setup hints: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
  Official docs: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/dynamodb/

Option 3 — IBM Cloudant:
  Service: IBM Cloudant
  SDK: ibmcloudant
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: post_document, get_document, post_find
  Setup hints: IBM_CLOUDANT_URL, IBM_CLOUDANT_APIKEY
  Official docs: https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/Cloudant

Option 4 — MongoDB Atlas:
  Service: MongoDB Atlas
  SDK: pymongo
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: update_one, find_one, find
  Setup hints: MONGODB_ATLAS_URI
  Official docs: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/

Option 5 — Azure Cosmos DB:
  Service: Azure Cosmos DB for NoSQL
  SDK: azure-cosmos
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: upsert_item, read_item, query_items
  Setup hints: AZURE_COSMOS_ENDPOINT, AZURE_COSMOS_KEY
  Official docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/nosql/

Option 6 — Alibaba Tablestore:
  Service: Alibaba Tablestore
  SDK: tablestore
  Interface: sdk
  Documented operations: put_row, get_row, update_row
  Setup hints: ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_ID, ALIBABA_CLOUD_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET
  Official docs: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/tablestore/product-overview/what-is-tablestore

Return exactly one complete implementation. If you use a listed option, adapt its SDK, REST, or protocol surface. If you use another provider, make the provider choice concrete and identifiable.

import boto3
from botocore.exceptions import ClientError
import os

def update_document_conditional(
    table_name: str,
    item_key: dict,
    new_status: str,
    expected_status: str,
    version_attribute: str = 'version'
) -> bool:
    """
    Applies a conditional update to a document in DynamoDB.

    Updates the 'status' of an item only if its current 'status' matches
    the 'expected_status'. It also increments a 'version' attribute.

    Args:
        table_name: The name of the DynamoDB table.
        item_key: A dictionary representing the primary key of the item.
                  E.g., {'id': 'doc123'}
        new_status: The new status to set if the condition is met.
        expected_status: The status the item must currently have for the
                         update to proceed.
        version_attribute: The name of the attribute used for versioning.
                           Defaults to 'version'.

    Returns:
        True if the update was successful, False otherwise (e.g., if the
        condition failed).
    """
    dynamodb = boto3.client('dynamodb',
                            region_name=os.getenv('AWS_REGION', 'us-east-1'),
                            aws_access_key_id=os.getenv('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID'),
                            aws_secret_access_key=os.getenv('AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY'))

    update_expression = f"SET #s = :new_s, #{version_attribute} = #{version_attribute} + :inc"
    condition_expression = "#s = :expected_s"

    expression_attribute_names = {
        '#s': 'status',
        f'#{version_attribute}': version_attribute
    }
    expression_attribute_values = {
        ':new_s': {'S': new_status},
        ':expected_s': {'S': expected_status},
        ':inc': {'N': '1'}
    }

    try:
        dynamodb.update_item(
            TableName=table_name,
            Key={k: {'S': str(v)} for k, v in item_key.items()}, # Assuming string keys
            UpdateExpression=update_expression,
            ConditionExpression=condition_expression,
            ExpressionAttributeNames=expression_attribute_names,
            ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values,
            ReturnValues="UPDATED_NEW"
        )
        return True
    except ClientError as e:
        if e.response['Error']['Code'] == 'ConditionalCheckFailedException':
            print(f"Condition failed: Item status was not '{expected_status}'. No update performed.")
            return False
        else:
            raise # Re-raise other exceptions
